svg.title: How UV painting reaches every matching card
svg.desc: Before: leaf cards A, B and C have different greyscale values. All three share a UV island and material. Draw a gradient from 0 to 1 on that island. After: all three cards have the same stem-to-tip gradient. Cards on another UV island or using another material are unchanged in Card Under Cursor mode.
svg.text: ONE UV GRADIENT → ALL MATCHING COPIES
Example: paint the R channel from 0 at the stem to 1 at the tip.
A, B and C overlap at these UV coordinates.
Drag once from stem to tip
All matching copies get the gradient
0 at the stem → 1 at the tip
It does not share the painted coordinates.
Its paint stays as it was.
Even with the same UV coordinates, it is excluded.
Its paint stays as it was.
You can also paint one card by hand and use Copy to Same UV to transfer its values.
